_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Building a custom quote, this will take several minutes

description: Submit one quote request to Detritus for dumpster, portable sanitation, and/or other jobsite services. All items for one job go in a single request and produce a single quote. Creates a customer record and quote request at Detritus and sends the customer a text and/or email with their quote. Requires the customer's first name, last name, email, phone, full delivery address, delivery date, and selected products, and customerConfirmed: true after the customer has reviewed those details. Not safe to retry: calling it again for the same job creates a duplicate request. Returns serviceRequestId.

customerConfirmed.description: Must be true. Set only after the user reviewed and confirmed first name, last name, email, phone, full delivery address, products, and delivery date.

request.description: One quote request: contact, full delivery address, delivery date, and every product for the job.

address.description: Full delivery address: street, city, state, and ZIP.

crewSize.description: Approximate crew size, used to size sanitation for the job.

dumpsterRentalOption.description: Dumpster rental category, when the customer named one.

dumpsterSize.description: Dumpster size id from get_service_availability. Put this on the SAME request as products[] when the customer also wants a porta potty.

duration.description: How long the rental is needed, such as 7 days or 2 weeks.

phone.description: Customer's phone number, at least 10 digits.

products.description: Porta-potty / sanitation product ids from get_service_availability. Include every sanitation product the customer wants, on this same request as any dumpster or siteServices[].

projectDetails.description: Required when requesting more than one product (e.g. porta + dumpster). Goes on the Form Lead as Project Details.

projectType.description: Kind of project, such as roofing, remodel, or event.

rentalType.description: Job type. Dumpster-only must be construction or personal. Porta + dumpster may use construction (typical job site).

siteServices.description: Other jobsite services from get_service_availability siteServices (fencing, storage, water, power). Put them on this same request as dumpster and sanitation.

units.description: How many units to deliver, if the customer specified a count.

name: make_service_request
title: Submit quote request
